```{r}
library(gamlss)
library(gamlss.ggplots)
library(gamlssTools)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("2_wrangling/2_1_data_wrangling.R")
```

#### select gender, age range, winsorise
```{r}
ESM = "NeishabouriCount_vm"
gender = 2
aa_ig = "IG" # "AvAcc" or "IG"
```

```{r}

ESM_aa = ESM
ESM_ig = paste0("ig_gradient_", ESM)


gender_df = all_df_participant |>
  filter(gender == !!gender) |>
  rename(
    pa_measure = if_else(
      aa_ig == "IG",
      paste0("M14_", ESM_ig, "_mg_0-24hr"),
      paste0("M14_", ESM_aa, "_mg_0-24hr")
    )
  )

    
```

#### inspect
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
# histogram
histogram = gender_df |>
  pull(pa_measure) |>
  y_hist()

# scatter over age
scatter = gender_df |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(age, pa_measure), alpha = .2)

histogram + scatter + plot_annotation(
  caption = paste(ESM, aa_ig, gender) 
)
```

##### create base model and run chooseDist
```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
# base model
m1 = gamlss(
  pa_measure ~ pb(age),
  sigma.formula = ~ pb(age),
  nu.formula = ~ pb(age),
  tau.formula = ~ pb(age),
  family=NO,
  data=gender_df,
  control = gamlss.control(n.cyc = 50)
)

# test distributions
f_type = if_else(aa_ig == "AvAcc", "realplus", "realline")

t1 = chooseDist(m1, type = f_type, parallel = "snow", ncpus = detectCores()-1)

if (aa_ig == "IG"){t1 = t1[-2,]} #GU family errors

model_GAIC_lollipop(t1, which = 1) + plot_annotation(
  caption = paste(ESM, aa_ig, gender) 
)

```

#### update model distribution, run diagnostics
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}

best_family = names(getOrder(t1, 1)[1])

# update based on best AIC (can do chi-square or BIC and more)
m1.update = update(
  m1,
  family = best_family,
  control = gamlss.control(n.cyc = 100)
  )

# plot fitted means versus scatter
fitted_df = data.frame(gender_df, fitted_mean = fitted(m1.update))
fitted_mean = ggplot(fitted_df) +
  geom_point(aes(age, pa_measure), alpha = .2) +
  geom_line(aes(age, fitted_mean), col = "red", linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Fitted mean for model m1.update")

# diagnostics
qqplot = resid_qqplot(m1.update) + theme_classic()
wormplot = resid_wp(m1.update) + theme_classic()
bucketplot = moment_bucket(m1.update) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("Bucket-plot for model m1.update")

(fitted_mean + qqplot) / (bucketplot + wormplot) + plot_annotation(
  caption = paste(ESM, aa_ig, gender) 
)

```

#### fitted centiles
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

fitted_centiles_legend(m1.update, cent = c(97, 90, 75, 50, 25, 10, 3)) +
  theme_classic() + plot_annotation(
  caption = paste(ESM, aa_ig, gender) 
)

```

```{r}
og_centiles_zscores = pred_og_centile(
  m1.update,
  gender_df,
  get.std.scores = TRUE
  )

og_df = data.frame(
  gender_df,
  centiles = round(og_centiles_zscores$centile * 100, 1),
  z_scores = round(og_centiles_zscores$std_score, 2)
  ) |>
  rename(
    !!sym(paste("centiles", ESM, aa_ig, sep = "_")) := centiles,
    !!sym(paste("z_scores", ESM, aa_ig, sep = "_")) := z_scores
  )

if (aa_ig == "IG"){
  og_df = og_df |> 
    rename(!!sym(paste0("M14_", ESM_ig, "_mg_0-24hr")) := pa_measure)
} else {
  og_df = og_df |> 
    rename(!!sym(paste0("M14_", ESM_aa, "_mg_0-24hr")) := pa_measure)
}

write_rds(og_df, paste0("centile_dataframes/", ESM, aa_ig, gender, ".rds"))
```


#### centiles for plotting
```{r}

sim_df = sim_data(gender_df, "age", gamlssModel = m1.update)

centiles_df = centile_predict(
  m1.update,
  sim_df,
  "age",
  desiredCentiles = c(0.03, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.97)
)

write_rds(centiles_df, paste0("plotting_dataframes/", ESM, aa_ig, gender, ".rds"))

ggplot(centiles_df$fanCentiles_df) +
  geom_line(aes(age, cent_0.03), colour = "blue") +
  geom_line(aes(age, cent_0.1), colour = "cyan") +
  geom_line(aes(age, cent_0.25), colour = "green") +
  geom_line(aes(age, cent_0.5), colour = "yellow") +
  geom_line(aes(age, cent_0.75), colour = "orange") +
  geom_line(aes(age, cent_0.9), colour = "red") +
  geom_line(aes(age, cent_0.97), colour = "violet")

```
